explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 105 named tracks and releases across Juno's September 15 same-day and weekly techno pages, current back-in-stock techno records, adjacent electro and drum-and-bass releases, and overlooked catalogue/reissue material. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The canonical ledger, annotations, journey map, discussion and revisit queues, rejected and discovery histories, inspiration files, publication state and global utility ledger were audited first. UTF-8, JSON, count, map-order, receipt and protected-order checks passed; no objective defect, listener authorization, triggered revisit or unfinished repair required REPAIR.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, placement-specific REJECT and previously unresolved exact artist/title identity was excluded. Eight fresh exact-title leads remain; no ranking slot was filled for resolver convenience.
The post-recurrence evidence guard was applied. One lead per release was retained, and each selected-slot contender has differentiated exact-track prose rather than shared release framing alone.

Planned placements were compared with the previous five completed discovery runs. Recently evaluated boundaries were avoided; the incomplete Run 269 request was preserved as a failed request rather than treated as musical evidence.

Generic current preorders, unreviewed listings, prestige-only reissues, recent persistent identities and tracks supported only by album-level genre framing were inspected but excluded from the resolver request.

Source descriptions remain attributed prose, not measurements. No energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, perceived pulse, mixability or transition quality was inferred. Neither listener-protected handoff was split.

Rank reflects evidence specificity, selection-lens relevance, canonical potential and information gain, not novelty, orthodoxy, diversity, technical cleverness, artist prestige or a fixed chapter map.
sourceWindows: CURRENT: Juno's September 15 same-day and weekly techno pages were screened across releases, reviewed stock and preorders, checked 2026-09-15. ANGAMA's same-day Dotei record supplied a fresh exact-track development proposition. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/today/ and https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/this-week/

ADJACENT / EMERGING: Juno's current back-in-stock window supplied exact-track accounts spanning Michelle's electro, Last Life's halftime and LNS's broken-beat acid, checked 2026-09-15. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/back-in-stock/

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / RECIRCULATION: Back-in-stock and catalogue paths returned DJ Sneak's May 2026 loop construction, A Morgan's August 2026 linear-drum record and Barnt's 15th-anniversary remaster; recent persistent identities and generic listings were excluded. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/back-in-stock/
